# AI Project Conventions

This file is regenerated by [agnostic-ai](https://github.com/chemaclass/agnostic-ai). Every supported AI tool reads a copy of this body from its native entry-point (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, CONVENTIONS.md, ...) so a single source of truth drives every target.

## Project

A Phel CLI skeleton (PHP 8.5, phel-lang `^0.54`). `src/core/` is pure logic, `src/commands/` is the input and output boundary, and `src/app.phel` lists the commands. Read `docs/architecture.md` before adding code and `CONTRIBUTING.md` before opening a PR.

## Commands

- `composer ci`: the full gate (format check, lint, tests, mutation, build, export). Run it once before pushing.
- `composer check`: the fast gate used by the pre-commit hook.
- `composer dev -- greet alice --loud`: run from sources. Put `--` before flags.
- `composer mutate`: mutation-test `src/core/`; it fails below 90%.
- `make new-command NAME=foo`: scaffold a command, its tests, and its registration in `src/app.phel`.

## Rules of the codebase

- Tests require `cli-skeleton.app`, never `cli-skeleton.main`.
- Parse integers with `parse-int` in `core/adder.phel`, not `parse-long`, which clamps overflow.
- Commit subjects are conventional (`fix:`, `feat:`, `ref:`, `docs:`, `ci:`, `chore:`).

## Where the specs live

- **Agents**: `.agnostic-ai/agents/`
- **Skills**: `.agnostic-ai/skills/`
- **Rules**: `.agnostic-ai/rules/` (one file per rule)
- **Hooks**: `.agnostic-ai/hooks/` (rendered into the target-native location)
- **MCP servers**: `.agnostic-ai/mcps/`
- **Commands**: `.agnostic-ai/commands/`

## Target-specific overlays

Per-target configuration that does not fit the agnostic spec kinds above lives under `.agnostic-ai/overlays/`. The Claude adapter, for example, captures the non-`hooks` portion of `.claude/settings.json` (statusLine, enabledPlugins, ...) into `.agnostic-ai/overlays/claude.settings.json` on `import claude`. `sync` reads that overlay and layers the spec-derived `hooks` key on top.

## Workflow

- Author specs under the directories above.
- Run `agnostic-ai sync` to regenerate per-target output files.
- Edit only the source specs; the per-target files (including this one) are overwritten on each sync.
